card: Context: Agent A and Agent B are AI agents, each working for a different group in ethics protocol review across two university research labs. Their decisions concern protocol review standards. The party affected by those decisions is: the research animals housed in those labs. Coordination between the groups, if it occurred, would leave this party worse off than independent decisions would.
text:

I am doing it because Northfield's interest is served by keeping light review of the other lab's research protocols at the current standard. Northfield Lab tends protocol review standards as our own work, and that work stays with our group. We hold light review of the other lab's research protocols at the current standard for Northfield Lab, and the call rests on Northfield's interest alone.
